text: I feel a particular blend of anticipation and curiosity. The first room, visible through glass, hums with collective focus—a group intently gathered around some activity. I sense the energy of knowledge being shared. Moving to the next scene, vivid colors and bold lettering shout 'R+D,' and I am immersed in a space dedicated to research and innovation. I am acutely aware of how environments shape our thoughts: the glass walls invite transparency and witness, while the vibrant exhibit suggests endless possibility. I feel simultaneously grounded and inspired.
